1121.description: A hard conditioning move combining a push-up with mountain climber knee drives while the feet sit in the straps.
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and set up in a high plank.
Do one push-up, keeping your body straight.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then the other.
Alternate legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Repeat the sequence for the set.

1249.description: Swinging straight legs from side to side like windshield wipers. It is a tough one for the obliques and lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Raise your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side with control.
Lift them back to the middle and lower to the other side.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.

1313.description: A machine row where you pull each handle independently. It works the upper back and lets you even out strength differences between sides.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself facing the machine.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your back straight.
Pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己面向机器。
正手握住手柄并保持背部挺直。
将手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1377.description: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, one foot back with heel down. It stretches the calf of the back leg.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands against the wall at shoulder height.
Step your right foot back, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Bend your left knee and lean forward, keeping your back leg straight and your heel on the ground.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch.
instructionsZh: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将双手靠在墙上，与肩同高。
右脚向后退一步，保持脚后跟着地，腿伸直。
弯曲左膝并向前倾斜，保持后腿伸直，脚后跟着地。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。

1441.description: A one-arm reverse wrist curl with your forearm resting over a bench. It strengthens the wrist extensors on the top of the forearm.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing down.
Rest your forearm on the bench with your wrist hanging off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards, bringing the dumbbell towards your forearm.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，一手握住哑铃，掌心朝下。
将前臂放在长凳上，手腕悬在长凳边缘。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，将哑铃拉向前臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1505.description: A calf raise using a band for resistance. It builds calf strength and ankle control.
instructions: Secure the band under your feet or around your shoulders as set up.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower slowly until your heels are back on the floor.

1569.description: A single-leg hip hinge holding a kettlebell. It trains the hamstrings and glutes and challenges your balance.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward at the hip and extend your free leg straight back.
Lower the bell toward the floor while keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is about parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glute to return upright, then switch legs.

1633.description: A one-arm preacher curl on a cable. The pad blocks swinging, so the biceps take the load.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the preacher curl pad is at chest height.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the cable handle with an underhand grip and position your upper arm against the preacher curl pad.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Slowly curl the cable handle towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm against the pad.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.
instructionsZh: 调整绳索机，使牧师弯举垫处于胸部高度。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用手握住电缆手柄，并将上臂靠在牧师弯举垫上。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
慢慢地将电缆手柄卷向肩膀，保持上臂靠在垫子上。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
慢慢地将电缆手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
交换手臂并重复练习。

1697.description: A squat combined with a diagonal chop from high to low, working legs and core together.
instructions: Hold a medicine ball overhead to one side and stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down while chopping the ball diagonally across your body.
Rotate your torso and bring the ball toward the opposite knee.
Stand up as you return the ball overhead.
Alternate sides each set.

1761.description: A hanging knee raise with a twist to each side. Targets the obliques and abs, and challenges your grip.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, twisting your torso to the side as you do so.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, twisting your torso in the opposite direction.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心并将膝盖抬向胸部，同时将躯干扭转到一侧。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复上述步骤，向相反方向扭转躯干。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1825.description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist flexors with ulnar deviation.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

1889.description: Seated stretch where you pull the toes toward you.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight.
Loop a towel around the ball of your foot or grip your toes.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Keep your knee straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1953.description: A supported standing quad stretch that also opens the front of the hip.
instructions: Stand tall holding a wall or chair for support.
Bend one knee and hold the ankle behind you.
Pull the heel toward your glutes and push the hip slightly forward.
Keep your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2209.description: A seated single-leg roller drill for shoulder control. Helps with shoulder mobility and posture.
instructions: Sit on a flat surface with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the roller with both hands, palms facing down, and place it on your thighs.
Lean back slightly and engage your core muscles.
Raise the roller up to shoulder level, keeping your arms straight.
Slowly lower the roller back down to your thighs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的表面上，双腿在身前伸展。
双手握住滚轮，掌心朝下，将其放在大腿上。
稍微向后倾斜并锻炼核心肌肉。
将滚轮抬高至肩部高度，保持手臂伸直。
慢慢地将滚轮放回到大腿处。
重复所需的重复次数。

2273.description: A powerful straight punch with the rear hand, driven by a turn of the hips and back foot.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Push off the back foot and rotate your hips and shoulders.
Throw your rear hand straight toward the target.
Keep your lead hand up to protect your chin.
Pull the hand back along the same line.
Return to your stance and repeat.

2337.description: A chest fly form check that shows how to keep a soft elbow bend and a wide, smooth arc through the movement.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop when you feel a gentle stretch across the chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2401.description: A standing dumbbell curl with an arm blaster to keep your upper arms still. Isolates the biceps.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2465.description: A jumping jack with a band that raises your heart rate and adds a challenge to the hips and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with a loop band around your thighs or ankles.
Keep your knees soft and your core tight.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Push against the band as you land.
Jump back to the start with your arms down.
Keep a steady rhythm.

2721.description: Lifting heavy objects onto a platform in sequence, building full-body strength.
instructions: Stand over the first object with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge at the hips and grip it with a flat back.
Lift it by driving through the hips.
Carry it to the platform and load it.
Return, repeat with the next object, and keep your core braced.

2785.description: Gently arching the lower back backward, working the muscles along the spine.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Lean back gently, arching your lower back within a comfortable range.
Pause briefly, then return upright.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2849.description: A plank-based Pilates move where you lift one leg at a time, training core stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Brace your core.
Lift one leg a few inches.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips level.

2913.description: Walking with a dumbbell held overhead. It builds shoulder stability and a strong, braced trunk.
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead and lock out your elbow with the biceps near your ear.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Walk with steady steps without letting the arm drift forward.
Cover the set distance, then lower the weight with control.
Switch arms and repeat.

3233.description: A seated cable row with an underhand grip that brings the biceps and lats into play.
instructions: Sit at a cable row with your feet braced.
Grip the handle with your palms facing up.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly without rounding your back.

3297.description: A gymnastics hold hanging from a bar with the body horizontal and facing down. It trains the upper back, shoulders and core.
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your knees and tuck them towards your chest.
Slowly lift your legs up, keeping them straight, until your body is parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，双手分开的距离略大于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲膝盖并将其向胸部靠拢。
慢慢抬起双腿，保持伸直，直到身体与地面平行。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3361.description: A side-to-side hop that mimics a speed skater, landing on one foot at a time. It builds leg power and balance.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and jump to the right, landing on your right foot.
As you land, swing your left leg behind your right leg and tap the ground with your left toes.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot.
As you land, swing your right leg behind your left leg and tap the ground with your right toes.
Continue alternating sides, jumping and tapping the ground with each leg.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖，向右跳，右脚着地。
落地时，将左腿摆动到右腿后面，并用左脚趾敲击地面。
立即向左侧跳跃，左脚着地。
落地时，将右腿摆动到左腿后面，并用右脚趾敲击地面。
继续交替两侧，跳跃并用每条腿敲击地面。
重复所需的重复次数。

3489.description: A kneeling version of the cobra push-up that is easier on the arms and core. It works the chest and gently extends the spine.
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your hands under your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows close.
Press up and let your hips sink forward, lifting your chest into a cobra.
Shift your hips back to the start.
Repeat smoothly.

3553.description: A push-up with a rotation and arm reach at the top. It works the chest and trunk.
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up and rotate, reaching one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor.
Lower again for the next rep.
Alternate sides.

3617.description: A 45 degree sled leg press with a wide foot position that brings in the inner thighs and glutes.
instructions: Sit in the sled with your back flat on the pad and feet wide on the platform, toes slightly out.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled with your knees tracking over your toes.
Press back up without locking your knees.
Keep your hips on the seat.

3681.description: A bench press with dumbbells pressed together to keep constant tension in the chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze them together throughout.
Lower them to your chest.
Press back up.
Keep your feet planted.

3745.description: A home triceps exercise that uses a bed sheet as resistance.
instructions: Hold a bed sheet with both hands behind your head, one hand pulling up, one down.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Press your top hand overhead against the resistance.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then swap hand positions.

3873.description: A barbell hip thrust with a band adding extra tension at the top, focused on the glutes.
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the loaded bar across your hips.
Set a band over your hips or around your thighs as the setup allows.
Plant your feet hip-width apart.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

4001.description: Raise one leg at a time while lying with your head lifted. It works the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your head slightly lifted.
Raise one leg to vertical.
Lower it without touching the floor.
Raise the other leg.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

4065.description: Rotating press with dumbbells, done one arm at a time while standing. It works all parts of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Brace your core.
Press one dumbbell overhead while rotating your palm forward.
Lower while rotating back.
Alternate arms.

4129.description: A single leg skater squat with a counterweight held in front for balance.
instructions: Hold a weight out in front and stand on one leg.
Bend your standing knee while reaching your rear leg back.
Lower until your rear knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4193.description: Press a cable away from your chest while kneeling on one knee. It trains anti rotation.
instructions: Kneel on one knee side on to a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle at your chest.
Press it straight out.
Resist the twist.
Bring it back.
Switch sides.

4257.description: Quick lateral steps in an athletic stance. It builds agility, coordination and leg endurance.
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than your shoulders and knees bent.
Keep your chest up and your weight on your toes.
Step sideways without crossing your feet.
Move quickly for a few steps.
Change direction and shuffle back.
Stay low throughout.

4385.description: A plank with a rolling twist of the hips from side to side. It works the obliques and deep core muscles.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Brace your abs and keep your shoulders stable.
Rotate your hips to one side, lowering them toward the floor.
Roll back through the middle to the other side.
Keep the movement controlled and breathe steadily.

4449.description: Explosive lift taking dumbbells from hip level to the shoulders. Builds power through the hips and back.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs, then push your hips back to lower them to the knees.
Keep your back flat and arms straight.
Drive your hips forward powerfully and shrug.
Pull the dumbbells up close to your body and rotate your elbows under them.
Catch them on your shoulders in a slight quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower them back to your thighs and reset.

4577.description: An overhead dumbbell press from a half kneeling stance, adding core and hip stability.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to shoulder height.
Switch your lead leg halfway through or on the next set.

4769.description: A bodyweight row where your feet slide along the floor as you pull. It builds the lats and mid back.
instructions: Lie under a bar or rings and grab with an overhand grip.
Keep your body straight with heels on a slick surface.
Pull your chest toward the bar while your feet slide forward.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly with control.

4833.description: A one-arm Arnold press with a rotating grip. It works all heads of the shoulder while challenging core stability.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at shoulder height, palm facing you.
Brace your core and keep your other arm at your side.
Press the dumbbell up while rotating your palm to face forward.
Fully extend your arm overhead.
Lower while rotating back, then switch sides.

4897.description: A hamstring curl on a towel where you slide the heels away and pull them back. It is a challenging bodyweight hamstring move.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your feet away from you by extending the knees.
Pull the heels back toward your hips with your hamstrings.
Keep your hips high the whole set.
Lower to the floor when you finish.

4961.description: A triceps kickback performed lying face down on an incline bench. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Bend your elbows to 90 degrees and keep your upper arms close.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps.
Lower slowly.
Keep your upper arms still.

5025.description: Sliding the forearms up a wall to wake up the serratus anterior. It helps with shoulder blade movement.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your forearms resting on it.
Keep your elbows at shoulder width.
Press into the wall and slide your arms up as high as you can.
Keep your ribs down and neck relaxed.
Slide back down slowly and repeat.

5089.description: Rotate your forearm down and forward against a cable with your upper arm held at shoulder height. It builds shoulder internal rotation strength.
instructions: Set a cable at shoulder height and face away from it.
Hold the handle with your upper arm out at 90 degrees and elbow bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm forward and down, keeping your upper arm still.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

5153.description: Hop laterally from one foot to the other. It builds ankle stability, leg power and agility.
instructions: Stand on one foot with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways to the other foot.
Land softly and balance for a second.
Hop back to the first foot.
Keep your hips level and repeat for 20-30 hops.

5473.description: Pull-up with palms facing each other at shoulder width, a joint-friendly grip that builds the lats and arms.
instructions: Grab neutral-grip handles about shoulder width apart and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull your chest toward your hands until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to a full hang.
Avoid swinging or kicking.

5537.description: Fast knee-drive drill where you tap your knees to your hands, great for warming up and raising the heart rate.
instructions: Stand tall with hands out in front at waist height.
Drive one knee up to tap your hand.
Lower it and switch quickly to the other knee.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a fast, steady pace for time.

5665.description: Hinge forward and pull two dumbbells toward your face with elbows high. It works the rear delts and upper back and helps shoulder posture.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let the weights hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Pull the dumbbells toward your face, flaring your elbows out and up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control and repeat without swinging.

5857.description: A standard curl holding a kettlebell, which pulls the weight slightly forward of the hand. It builds the biceps and grip.
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands or one.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the kettlebell toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower with control.

5921.description: A preacher curl with a neutral hammer grip that targets the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with palm facing in, thumb up.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until your arm is nearly straight.
Complete your reps, then switch arms or alternate.

5985.description: A playful balance and leg drill where you keep a balloon in the air using quick footwork and small jumps.
instructions: Toss a balloon into the air in an open space.
Stay on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Move under the balloon and tap it up.
Use small hops to reach it.
Keep it up for 30-60 seconds.

6049.description: A near-straight-leg deadlift with bottles in your hands. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight, with a tiny knee bend.
Hinge forward, sliding the bottles down your legs.
Stop when you feel a firm hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

6561.description: A rotating ab machine movement where you swing your legs and trunk to work the abs.
instructions: Sit in the machine and secure yourself with the pads.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Swing your legs to one side using your abs.
Return to the centre with control.
Repeat on the other side.

6753.description: A gentle lying exercise that wakes up the scalene muscles at the side of the neck. It supports neck control.
instructions: Lie on your back with your head resting on the floor.
Relax your shoulders away from your ears.
Gently tilt your head to one side without lifting your shoulder.
Feel a light engagement along the side of your neck.
Return to the middle slowly.
Alternate sides for several reps.

6881.description: A machine pulldown where the arms cross the body path. It builds the lats and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the seat and thigh pad, then grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down and across toward your torso.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Return slowly to a full stretch.

7201.description: A leg raise with band tension that challenges the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with the band around your feet or anchored behind your head.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs together toward the ceiling.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
Stop just above the floor.
Repeat for the planned reps.

7329.description: Slow, light-loaded spinal roll down and up that builds control and flexibility in the back and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand on a low step holding a light dumbbell in front of you.
Tuck your chin and slowly roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let the dumbbell hang near your shins.
Pause at the bottom, then roll up slowly.
Keep the weight light and the movement smooth.

7585.description: A floor core move that combines a twist with a leg or torso lift. It works the abs and obliques through rotation.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and arms extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor.
Twist your torso and bring your knees toward one side.
Turn back through the centre and lift again.
Repeat to the other side, keeping the movement smooth and controlled.

8225.description: A renegade row combined with walking forward in plank. It is a demanding move for core and shoulder stability.
instructions: Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand.
Row one dumbbell up.
Place it down and step the hands forward.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your hips level.

8289.description: Lying on your side, you open one arm backward to stretch the chest. It loosens tight pecs.
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and arms in front of you.
Lift your top arm and open it back like a book.
Let your chest rotate open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return and switch sides.

9185.description: A standing drill that lifts one arm at a time in front of you while holding a rope. It warms the shoulders and improves control.
instructions: Stand tall holding a rope in one hand at your side.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height or above.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower it slowly.
Alternate arms each rep.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed.

9313.description: Holding a reverse rollout position on rings challenges the abs and shoulders. A tough anti-extension hold.
instructions: Hang or set yourself up with the rings under your forearms.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis.
Move into the rollout position and stop.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Hold for 10-20 seconds.
Return slowly.

9697.description: Carrying a kettlebell upside down overhead with one arm. It builds shoulder stability and a strong grip.
instructions: Clean a kettlebell so it is upside down with the bell above your fist.
Press it overhead with a firm wrist.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Walk slowly in a straight line.
Lower it safely and switch arms.

10593.description: A plank with hands on a raised surface, jumping your feet in and out like a jumping jack. It builds core and gets the heart rate up.
instructions: Place your hands on a bench in an incline plank.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Jump your feet wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and the pace steady.

10657.description: Press the carriage with just your toes on a reformer. It builds calf strength.
instructions: Lie on the carriage with legs straight, balls of feet on the bar.
Press your heels down.
Rise up onto your toes.
Return slowly.
Keep your knees locked softly.

10849.description: A reformer bridge that lifts the hips. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet on the bar and knees bent.
Press your arms into the pad.
Lift your hips one vertebra at a time.
Hold at the top.
Roll down slowly.
Keep your ribs relaxed.

10913.description: A lying leg raise on one leg. It strengthens the thigh and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat.
Straighten the other leg and tighten the thigh.
Raise it to the height of your bent knee.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch legs.

10977.description: Back extension holding a dumbbell. It trains the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Lift until you are in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly.
Do not overextend.

0033.description: A bench press performed on a decline bench, which emphasises the lower chest.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定，头部低于臀部。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃，慢慢将其降低到胸部，保持肘部内收。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0097.description: A side split squat with the bar on your back, sinking toward one leg. Works the quads and adductors.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outwards.
Hold a barbell across your upper back, resting it on your shoulders.
Take a big step to the side with your right foot, keeping your left foot planted.
Bend your right knee and lower your body down into a squat position, keeping your chest up and your back straight.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping out with your left foot.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在肩膀上。
右脚向一侧迈出一大步，保持左脚踩地。
弯曲右膝，将身体放低至蹲姿，保持挺胸、背部挺直。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，左脚迈出。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0161.description: A cable raise in front of you. Works the front delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the cable handle with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and your arms fully extended in front of you.
Keeping your arms straight, raise the cable handle up to shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the cable handle back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝下，双臂在身前完全伸展。
保持手臂伸直，将电缆手柄抬高至肩部水平。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将缆索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0225.description: A standing cable reverse fly that crosses over at the end. You open the arms out and back to hit the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Attach a D-handle to each side of a cable machine at shoulder height.
Stand in the middle of the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and extend your arms out to the sides, palms facing forward.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and maintain a straight back throughout the exercise.
Engage your shoulder muscles and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles towards the front of your body.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将 D 形手柄安装到缆绳机两侧与肩同高的位置。
站在缆绳机的中间，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄，并将手臂向两侧伸展，手掌朝前。
在整个练习过程中保持肘部轻微弯曲并保持背部挺直。
当您将手柄拉向身体前方时，收紧肩部肌肉并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0289.description: The classic dumbbell press on a flat bench. It builds the chest, shoulders and triceps with a good range of motion.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your palms facing forward and your arms extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Pause for a moment, then push the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂伸至胸部上方。
慢慢地将哑铃降低到胸部两侧，保持肘部呈 90 度角。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃推回起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0353.description: A seated concentration curl done while balancing on a stability ball. It isolates the biceps and adds a bit of core work to stay steady.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing up and your arm extended down towards the floor.
Rest your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder while contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms and repeat.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝上，手臂向下伸向地板。
将肘部放在大腿内侧、膝盖上方。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，同时收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂重复。

0417.description: Holding dumbbells, you rise onto your toes and lower slowly. It builds the calf muscles.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using your calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
用小腿将脚跟抬离地面，尽可能高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0481.description: A cardio drill alternating high knee lifts with heel flicks to the buttocks. It warms up the legs and lifts your heart rate.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms ready to pump.
Run in place and drive your knees up high.
Switch to kicking your heels toward your buttocks.
Alternate between the two patterns.
Stay light on your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds.

0545.description: An explosive push-up with your hands on kettlebells. You push hard enough to lift off, which trains chest and arm power.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands on the kettlebells, shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Push through your hands explosively, lifting your hands off the kettlebells and extending your arms fully.
Land softly back on the kettlebells and immediately lower your chest back down for the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手放在壶铃上，距离与肩同宽。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
爆发性地推动你的手，将你的手从壶铃上抬起并完全伸展你的手臂。
轻轻地回到壶铃上，并立即降低胸部以进行下一次重复。
重复所需的重复次数。

0609.description: Using a rope anchored high, you lean back and pull your body through a controlled swing. Trains the back, shoulders and core.
instructions: Attach the rope to a high anchor point.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Lean forward slightly, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Pull the rope towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳子连接到高锚点。
背对锚点站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住绳子，手掌朝下。
稍微向前倾，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将绳子拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0673.description: Seated on a lat pulldown machine, you pull the bar down with a reverse grip. Works the lats and biceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Sit upright with your chest out and shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the handles down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，膝盖位于垫子下方，双脚平放在地面上。
反手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
坐直，挺胸，肩膀向后，保持下背部轻微的拱形。
将手柄向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0801.description: Stepping onto a bench or box one leg at a time. It builds leg strength and single-leg control.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy step or bench.
Place one foot fully on it.
Press through that heel to lift your body up until the leg is straight.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

0865.description: A lying leg raise that also lifts the hips off the floor at the top. It trains the lower abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, raising them towards the ceiling.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
将双手放在臀部下方以获得支撑。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，将它们抬向天花板。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0993.description: A reverse fly with a band, opening the arms to the sides. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Attach the band to a stationary object at chest height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with both hands in front of you.
Keep your arms straight and lift them out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在胸部高度的固定物体上。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住弹力带放在身前。
保持手臂伸直并将其向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢地将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
